snippet.title: Saraab: Beyond the Veil (Release Date Trailer)
snippet.description:
A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons.

Elham’s search forces her to confront haunting visions, buried family secrets, and djinn inspired by Arabian lore. Each step of her inner healing unlocks new abilities and changes her reality.

Will you help her embrace the light, or let her fall into the darkness?

Wishlist Saraab: Beyond The Veil on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134310/Saraab_Beyond_The_Veil/

Coming to Steam on November 3, 2026.

Developed by: Rooted Elevation.

#SaraabBeyondTheVeil #PsychologicalHorror #VisualNovel #IndieGame
